		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一项目背景与站点需求分析">一、项目背景与站点需求分析</h2>
<p>目标站点：<code>https://bbab.net/images/gallery/</code>，是一套<strong>每日更新4K高清电脑桌面壁纸系统</strong>，核心特征：</p>
<ol>
<li>内容分层：风景、建筑、动物、城市多分类壁纸；</li>
<li>产品定位：CC0 无版权商用高清图库，海量 4K/8K 电脑壁纸，每日自动同步上新素材；</li>
<li>页面能力：响应式瀑布流、图片懒加载、时间线归档、分页、缩略图/原图 CDN 分离、图片预加载优化；</li>
<li>技术痛点：海量图片加载性能、海量素材分页查询、静态 CDN 分发、SEO 日期归档页面。</li>
</ol>
<p>本文提供<strong>Node.js Express 后端 + 原生 HTML/CSS/JS 前端 + SQLite 轻量数据库</strong>完整可运行代码，从零搭建同款壁纸画廊。</p>
<p><img alt="th" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715701/202608/3715701-20260810133525789-151439823.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="二整体技术架构">二、整体技术架构</h2>
<h3 id="技术栈选型">技术栈选型</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>分层</th>
<th>技术</th>
<th>作用</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>后端服务</td>
<td>Node.js + Express</td>
<td>提供壁纸分页、日期归档、分类筛选 API</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>数据库</td>
<td>sqlite3</td>
<td>存储壁纸元数据（日期、分类、缩略图、原图地址）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>前端页面</td>
<td>HTML5 + CSS3 Grid/Flex + 原生JS</td>
<td>画廊瀑布流、时间归档侧边栏、懒加载</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>静态资源</td>
<td>CDN 分离</td>
<td>缩略图小图预加载，原图高清分发</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>优化方案</td>
<td>IntersectionObserver 懒加载、WebP 格式、分页 LIMIT 偏移查询</td>
<td>解决大图加载卡顿</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="目录结构">目录结构</h3>
<pre><code>bbab-gallery/
├── server/
│   ├── db.js        # 数据库初始化
│   ├── index.js     # Express 服务入口
│   ├── routes.js    # 画廊接口
│   └── seed.js      # 测试壁纸数据填充
├── public/
│   ├── index.html   # 画廊主页面 /images/gallery
│   ├── css/style.css
│   └── js/gallery.js
├── gallery.db       # SQLite 数据库文件
└── package.json
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三后端完整代码实现">三、后端完整代码实现</h2>
<h3 id="1-packagejson-依赖配置">1. package.json 依赖配置</h3>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "name": "bbab-wallpaper-gallery",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "复刻https://bbab.net/images/gallery/壁纸图库",
  "main": "server/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "nodemon server/index.js",
    "start": "node server/index.js",
    "seed": "node server/seed.js"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.19.2",
    "sqlite3": "^5.1.7",
    "cors": "^2.8.5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "nodemon": "^3.1.4"
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-数据库初始化-serverdbjs">2. 数据库初始化 server/db.js</h3>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
const db = new sqlite3.Database('./gallery.db');

// 创建壁纸表：包含日期、分类、CDN地址、宽高
db.serialize(() =&gt; {
  db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wallpapers (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL, -- 风景/建筑/动物/城市
    upload_date TEXT NOT NULL, -- YYYY-MM-DD 归档日期
    thumb_url TEXT NOT NULL, -- CDN缩略图
    full_url TEXT NOT NULL, -- 高清原图
    width INTEGER,
    height INTEGER,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  )`);

  // 创建日期归档视图（用于侧边栏时间列表）
  db.run(`CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS date_archive AS
    SELECT DISTINCT upload_date FROM wallpapers
    ORDER BY upload_date DESC`);
});

module.exports = db;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-测试数据填充-serverseedjs">3. 测试数据填充 server/seed.js</h3>
<p>模拟站点 2026 每日更新壁纸数据：</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">const db = require('./db');
const sampleData = [
  {
    title: "山间云海自然风光",
    category: "风景",
    upload_date: "2026-08-10",
    thumb_url: "/thumbs/0810/001.webp",
    full_url: "/orig/0810/001.webp",
    width: 3840, height: 2160
  },
  {
    title: "城市摩天大楼夜景",
    category: "城市",
    upload_date: "2026-08-10",
    thumb_url: "/thumbs/0810/002.webp",
    full_url: "/orig/0810/002.webp",
    width: 3840, height: 2160
  },
  {
    title: "森林小鹿野生动物",
    category: "动物",
    upload_date: "2026-08-09",
    thumb_url: "/thumbs/0809/001.webp",
    full_url: "/orig/0809/001.webp",
    width: 3840, height: 2160
  }
];

const stmt = db.prepare(`
  INSERT INTO wallpapers (title,category,upload_date,thumb_url,full_url,width,height)
  VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
`);

sampleData.forEach(item =&gt; {
  stmt.run(item.title, item.category, item.upload_date, item.thumb_url, item.full_url, item.width, item.height);
});
stmt.finalize(() =&gt; {
  console.log("测试数据插入完成");
  db.close();
});
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-接口路由-serverroutesjs">4. 接口路由 server/routes.js</h3>
<p>提供三大核心接口：分页壁纸列表、日期归档列表、按日期筛选壁纸</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const db = require('./db');
const PAGE_SIZE = 12;

// 1. 获取全部日期归档（侧边栏时间列表）
router.get("/archive-dates", (req, res) =&gt; {
  db.all("SELECT * FROM date_archive", (err, rows) =&gt; {
    if(err) return res.status(500).json({code:500,msg:"数据库错误",err});
    res.json({code:200,data:rows});
  });
});

// 2. 分页获取壁纸，支持日期筛选 /api/wallpapers?page=1&amp;date=2026-08-10
router.get("/wallpapers", (req, res) =&gt; {
  const page = parseInt(req.query.page) || 1;
  const filterDate = req.query.date || "";
  const offset = (page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
  let sql = "SELECT * FROM wallpapers";
  let params = [];
  if(filterDate){
    sql += " WHERE upload_date = ?";
    params.push(filterDate);
  }
  sql += " ORDER BY upload_date DESC LIMIT ?,?";
  params.push(offset, PAGE_SIZE);

  // 查询当前页数据
  db.all(sql, params, (err, list) =&gt; {
    if(err) return res.status(500).json({code:500,msg:"查询失败"});
    // 查询总数计算分页
    let countSql = "SELECT COUNT(id) total FROM wallpapers";
    let countParams = [];
    if(filterDate){
      countSql += " WHERE upload_date = ?";
      countParams.push(filterDate);
    }
    db.get(countSql, countParams, (_, row) =&gt; {
      const total = row.total;
      const totalPage = Math.ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE);
      res.json({
        code:200,
        data:{
          list, page, PAGE_SIZE, total, totalPage
        }
      });
    });
  });
});

module.exports = router;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-服务入口-serverindexjs">5. 服务入口 server/index.js</h3>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">const express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');
const routes = require('./routes');
const app = express();
const PORT = 3000;

// 中间件
app.use(cors());
app.use(express.static("public")); // 托管前端静态页面
app.use("/api", routes);

// 画廊页面路由，映射 /images/gallery
app.get("/images/gallery", (req, res) =&gt; {
  res.sendFile(__dirname + "/../public/index.html");
});

app.listen(PORT, () =&gt; {
  console.log(`服务运行 http://localhost:${PORT}/images/gallery`);
});
</code></pre>
<h2 id="四前端页面完整代码复刻画廊-ui">四、前端页面完整代码（复刻画廊 UI）</h2>
<h3 id="1-publicindexhtml-主页面">1. public/index.html 主页面</h3>
<p>实现：顶部分类导航、左侧日期归档侧边栏、中间瀑布流画廊、分页控件、图片懒加载</p>
<pre><code class="language-html">&lt;!DOCTYPE html&gt;
&lt;html lang="zh-CN"&gt;
&lt;head&gt;
  &lt;meta charset="UTF-8"&gt;
  &lt;meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"&gt;
  &lt;title&gt;每日高清壁纸 | bbab Gallery&lt;/title&gt;
  &lt;link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/style.css"&gt;
&lt;/head&gt;
&lt;body&gt;
  &lt;header class="site-header"&gt;
    &lt;h1&gt;发现每日精彩壁纸&lt;/h1&gt;
    &lt;nav class="category-nav"&gt;
      &lt;span class="cat-item active" data-cat="all"&gt;全部&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;span class="cat-item" data-cat="风景"&gt;风景&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;span class="cat-item" data-cat="建筑"&gt;建筑&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;span class="cat-item" data-cat="动物"&gt;动物&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;span class="cat-item" data-cat="城市"&gt;城市&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;/nav&gt;
  &lt;/header&gt;

  &lt;div class="container"&gt;
    &lt;!-- 左侧日期归档 --&gt;
    &lt;aside class="archive-sidebar"&gt;
      &lt;h3&gt;更新归档&lt;/h3&gt;
      &lt;div id="dateList" class="date-list"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/aside&gt;
    &lt;!-- 壁纸画廊主区域 --&gt;
    &lt;main class="gallery-main"&gt;
      &lt;div id="wallGrid" class="wall-grid"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div id="pageBox" class="page-box"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/main&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;script src="/js/gallery.js"&gt;&lt;/script&gt;
&lt;/body&gt;
&lt;/html&gt;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-publiccssstylecss-样式还原原图站布局">2. public/css/style.css 样式（还原原图站布局）</h3>
<pre><code class="language-css">*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:system-ui}
body{background:#f5f7fa;color:#222}
.site-header{padding:20px 40px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee}
.site-header h1{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:12px}
.category-nav{display:flex;gap:16px}
.cat-item{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:99px;background:#eee;cursor:pointer}
.cat-item.active{background:#2563eb;color:#fff}

.container{display:flex;max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px;gap:24px}
.archive-sidebar{width:220px;flex-shrink:0}
.date-list{margin-top:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.date-item{padding:8px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}
.date-item:hover{background:#eef2ff}
.date-item.active{background:#dbeafe;color:#2563eb;font-weight:500}

.gallery-main{flex:1}
.wall-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:18px}

<h3 id="3-publicjsgalleryjs-交互逻辑懒加载分页日期筛选">3. public/js/gallery.js 交互逻辑（懒加载+分页+日期筛选）</h3>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">// 全局状态
const state = {
  currentPage:1,
  selectDate:"",
  dateListEl:document.getElementById("dateList"),
  gridEl:document.getElementById("wallGrid"),
  pageEl:document.getElementById("pageBox")
};

// 1. 初始化加载日期归档列表
async function loadArchiveDates(){
  const res = await fetch("/api/archive-dates");
  const {data} = await res.json();
  state.dateListEl.innerHTML = "";
  data.forEach(item=&gt;{
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "date-item";
    div.innerText = item.upload_date;
    div.dataset.date = item.upload_date;
    // 日期点击筛选壁纸
    div.onclick = ()=&gt;{
      document.querySelectorAll(".date-item").forEach(d=&gt;d.classList.remove("active"));
      div.classList.add("active");
      state.selectDate = item.upload_date;
      state.currentPage = 1;
      loadWallpapers();
    }
    state.dateListEl.appendChild(div);
  })
}

// 2. 加载壁纸列表并渲染
async function loadWallpapers(){
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  params.append("page",state.currentPage);
  if(state.selectDate) params.append("date",state.selectDate);
  const res = await fetch(`/api/wallpapers?${params.toString()}`);
  const {data} = await res.json();
  const {list,totalPage} = data;
  state.gridEl.innerHTML = "";

  // 渲染卡片 + 图片懒加载
  list.forEach(wall=&gt;{
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "wall-card";
    card.innerHTML = `
      &lt;img data-src="${wall.thumb_url}" alt="${wall.title}" class="lazy-img"&gt;
      &lt;p&gt;${wall.title}&lt;/p&gt;
    `;
    state.gridEl.appendChild(card);
  })
  // 开启懒加载
  initLazyLoad();
  // 渲染分页
  renderPage(totalPage);
}

// 3. IntersectionObserver 图片懒加载
function initLazyLoad(){
  const imgs = document.querySelectorAll(".lazy-img");
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=&gt;{
    entries.forEach(entry=&gt;{
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        const img = entry.target;
        img.src = img.dataset.src;
        observer.unobserve(img);
      }
    })
  },{rootMargin:"120px"});
  imgs.forEach(img=&gt;observer.observe(img));
}

// 4. 分页渲染
function renderPage(totalPage){
  state.pageEl.innerHTML = "";
  for(let i=1;i&lt;=totalPage;i++){
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.className = "page-btn";
    if(i === state.currentPage) btn.classList.add("active");
    btn.innerText = i;
    btn.onclick = ()=&gt;{
      state.currentPage = i;
      loadWallpapers();
      window.scrollTo(0,0);
    }
    state.pageEl.appendChild(btn);
  }
}

// 页面加载执行
window.onload = async ()=&gt;{
  await loadArchiveDates();
  loadWallpapers();
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五部署运行完整步骤">五、部署运行完整步骤</h2>
<ol>

</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>初始化数据库并插入测试壁纸数据</li>

<pre><code class="language-bash">npm run seed
</code></pre>
<ol start="3">

<pre><code class="language-bash">npm run dev
</code></pre>
<ol start="4">
<li>访问画廊页面：<code>http://localhost:3000/images/gallery</code></li>
</ol>
<h2 id="六站点核心功能优化方案对标-bbabnet-原版">六、站点核心功能优化方案（对标 bbab.net 原版）</h2>
<h3 id="1-海量图片性能优化">1. 海量图片性能优化</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>CDN 分离缩略图/原图</strong>：缩略图采用 WebP 低分辨率预加载，原图点击弹窗加载；</li>
<li><strong>IntersectionObserver 懒加载</strong>：仅视口内图片发起请求，减少网络消耗；</li>
<li>数据库分页 LIMIT 偏移查询，禁止一次性全量查询百万级壁纸；</li>
<li>静态资源开启 Nginx 缓存、gzip 压缩。</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="2-日期归档业务逻辑">2. 日期归档业务逻辑</h3>
<p>原版站点核心特色是<strong>按更新日期倒序归档</strong>，数据库使用视图快速去重日期列表，前端点击日期筛选对应当日上新壁纸，完全还原页面左侧时间线导航。</p>
<h3 id="3-扩展功能迭代可二次开发">3. 扩展功能迭代（可二次开发）</h3>
<ol>
<li>分类筛选接口：增加 category 参数过滤风景/城市壁纸；</li>
<li>图片弹窗预览：点击卡片弹出高清原图下载按钮；</li>
<li>定时爬虫脚本：每日自动同步 CC0 图库素材，实现站点“每日更新”特性；</li>
<li>搜索接口：基于壁纸标题模糊搜索；</li>
<li>SEO 优化：日期归档独立静态页面、图片 alt 标签、sitemap.xml。</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="七总结">七、总结</h2>
<p>本文完整复现 <code>https://bbab.net/images/gallery/</code> 壁纸图库的<strong>日期归档、瀑布流画廊、分页、图片懒加载</strong>核心能力，全栈代码开箱即用，轻量 SQLite 无需复杂数据库环境，适合独立开发者搭建高清壁纸、摄影素材展示类站点。</p>
